related.name: Regranix Private Limited
related.note: Wholly-owned subsidiary (CIN U2013MH2026PTC469366 per Form AOC-1; the Directors' Report prints it as U20131MH2026PTC469366), subsidiary since March 13, 2026. Form AOC-1 reports every financial line as 'Not Applicable' and records that Regranix commenced its business operations only during FY2026-27. A proposed related-party transaction places the Company's investment in Regranix - by way of subscription to equity shares, preference shares, debentures, bonds and/or other instruments, in one or more tranches, at arm's length - before members; the Audit Committee (a majority of Independent Directors) reviewed and approved it before the Board, and related parties abstain from voting under Regulation 23(4) of SEBI LODR. The stated rationale is to strengthen Regranix so it can expand its manufacturing capacity and emerge as a reliable, captive source of raw materials, reducing the Company's dependence on third-party suppliers and improving procurement certainty; investment is to be made tranche-wise, linked to Regranix's actual capital requirements, under Board monitoring.
